prompt: A Qwen2-VL-style encoder uses patch 14 with a 2x2 merge. How many tokens for a 1120x672 image?
What does the block-diagonal mask in patch-n-pack ensure?
options: Every patch attends to every other patch in the pack
A patch attends only to patches of the same image
Only the first image is processed
Patches attend only to earlier images
explanation: $M_{ij}=1$ only when positions $i,j$ belong to the same image block.

prompt: Four images of 256, 576, 729 and 1024 tokens are packed. How many attention score entries are computed (sum of squares)?
Why does M-RoPE support any image size without resizing?
options: Positions are (time,row,col) coordinates fed to a rotation, not slots in a learned table
explanation: Rotary positions are a deterministic function of the coordinates, so there is no table to run past.

prompt: A 30 minute video at 1 fps with 81 tokens per frame has how many visual tokens?
3x3 average pooling of a 24x24 token grid per frame leaves how many tokens per frame?
How does the KV cache grow with the number of visual tokens $N$, and how does prefill attention compute grow?
explanation: KV bytes $=2Lh_{kv}d_hNb$ is linear; the number of causal score pairs $N(N+1)/2$ is quadratic.

prompt: KV bytes per token for 32 layers, 8 KV heads, head dim 128, BF16 (in KiB)?
Why does Qwen2.5-VL use absolute timestamps for the temporal position?
options: To make frames appear in random order
So uneven frame spacing under dynamic FPS is represented faithfully and time-grounded answers are possible
To remove the need for a vision encoder
explanation: With dynamic sampling the frame index no longer measures elapsed time; timestamps do.
